evidence.observation: O2 at growth onset ~3.7 ppm after purge bottomed out near 3-5 ppm
Monotonic rise over five consecutive growth events: 4.6→8.9→12.7→18.7→24.3→26.0 ppm, i.e. ~7x increase at constant T and Ar
Thermocouple holds 750±1 °C at setpoint, heater power steady ~45%
Ar flow steady at 100 sccm, so the O2 rise is not a dilution/flow artifact
